newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala Nov coffee exports 396,423 60-kg bags.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala Nov coffee exports 396,423 60-kg bags.

text.p: Guatemala exported 396,423 60-kilo bags of coffee in November, up 58 percent from Nov. 1995, the National Coffee Association (Anacafe) said Friday.
The increase of 250,850 bags was due to favorable prices, not to a larger harvest, Anacafe president Julio Arrivillaga told Reuters.

"It is not that there was a larger harvest. It reflects the reality of the futures market. It was more attractive to export immediately instead of waiting until March because there is a big difference (in prices) between December and March," Arrivillaga said.
Arrivillaga said this year's production was 624,656 60-kilo bags through the first week of December.

Anacafe's most recent prediction for the 1996-1997 harvest is 3.45 to 3.6 million 60-kilo bags, Arrivillaga said. The prediction, which dates from late November, includes 3.2 million 60-kilo bags of exportable arabigo beans.
He said Anacafe continues to predict a harvest close to the 1995-1996 season when Guatemala exported 3.7 million 60-kilo bags of coffee.
